# offset<TAB>english      The pixel-aware wrapper supplies layout.

column2: Can you really take me down in a head-on attack!?
Oh! Circling around to attack from the flank—you're not bad.
That one even made me... itch a little!
You're surprisingly quick...!!
But remember this, too!!
On an uneven battlefield, $$行動力$$ (MOV) holds the key to victory!
In other words, someone with high $$行動力$$ can climb somewhere high or even jump down from a cliff in one go!!
Damn, you went around behind me!
That hit me right in the back! But...
On a real battlefield, with enemies and allies getting in the way...
you can't just slip around behind your opponent that easily!
Right now we're fighting with these sticks, but...
every weapon has its own traits...
If you can use a bow, spear, or whip, you can attack from afar without taking a counterattack...
Use them well, and you can draw enemies closer—or take down troublesome distant enemies first!
Though me...
I'm the sort who only uses axes and swords, so I'm not very interested in that kind of tactic!!
Everyone has weapons and attack styles they're naturally good at!
Remember well that what you can equip differs from person to person!!
Hey, hey! It applies to allies too, but...
No one can move through an enemy, you know!?
If you want to get behind me, you'll have to go around, even if it's a detour, within your movement range!
And after moving, always make sure to turn in the direction that benefits you...
Carelessly showing your back to the enemy will get you killed on the battlefield!
What kind of fighting is that?! There are all kinds of ways to deal with an enemy attack...?!
The difference between a pro and an amateur is knowing when to use counterattack, defense, and evasion to suit the situation!
Even while an enemy is attacking, if you know how, you can change your tactics in all sorts of ways!
In real combat, just because an enemy falls doesn't mean you should relax...
Don't forget to finish them off!!
If you leave a near-dead enemy lying around, their allies might use a $$回復薬$$ or something...
and bring them back!
But you can also deliberately keep an enemy alive and use them as a wall...
In a tight spot, that's an effective battle tactic.
And just between us, if you use human $$返り血（ＢＰ）$$ in the $$剣血$$ ritual...
a weapon's $$潜在能力$$ may awaken, making it more powerful—or so they say...
But apparently the weapon might be cursed instead, depending on the case...
so watch yourself!
You're not bad at all!
Not bad...
You're weak as hell...!
